name: Q3 report
about: What a Q3 or Q3 43 did with a file from Msetter, or what changed between two exports
title: ''
labels: q3-report
---

To make a report: in Msetter, pick Q3 or Q3 43, open two exports from your camera, and press Send. Or press Copy report and paste it here.

Before posting, check the report holds nothing you'd rather keep private. Issues are public.
